purpose: Teach: 車種/日本円/丸の内/新橋/読み物/スチール/ストリーム/ポータブル

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、不審な車種の追跡もされますね
lines.en: The police also track suspicious vehicle types, don't they?
lines.style: Steady, conversational tone. Phrases as an observation that invites confirmation. Even pacing, no rush. Respectfully curious rather than probing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、海外取引の日本円換算記録も精査されますね
lines.en: The police also scrutinize records of yen conversion for overseas transactions, don't they?
lines.style: Same observational register. Slightly more technical vocabulary but delivered with the same warm, confirming cadence. No condescension.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、丸の内地区の防犯パトロールも担当されますね
lines.en: The police also handle crime prevention patrols in the Marunouchi district, don't they?
lines.style: Maintains the pattern. Specific place name delivered with easy familiarity. Collaborative tone—acknowledging local knowledge.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、新橋地区の繁華街の警備も担当されますね
lines.en: The police also manage security in the busy entertainment districts around Shinbashi, don't they?
lines.style: Same warm, steady rhythm. Slight emphasis on 「繁華街」 register—acknowledging the livelier character of that area. Still inviting, not testing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、防犯啓発の読み物も配布されますね
lines.en: The police also distribute crime prevention awareness materials, don't they?
lines.style: Continuing the same collaborative inquiry. Straightforward—no edge. Comfortable silence would be acceptable after this.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、廃車のスチール部品の回収も指導されますね
lines.en: The police also oversee the collection of steel parts from scrapped vehicles, don't they?
lines.style: Slightly more specific question. Delivered with the same even warmth. No surprise in the voice—accepting this as part of the work without fanfare.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、通信ストリームの監視もされますね
lines.en: The police also monitor communication streams, don't they?
lines.style: Technical term ('communication streams') delivered naturally, not as jargon. Same asking-for-confirmation tone. Still warm.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、現場でのポータブル無線機もご使用ですね
lines.en: And you use portable radios out in the field, of course?
lines.style: Subtle shift—slightly closer, more direct. Moves from rhetorical observation to practical acknowledgment. Warmer, almost knowing. Natural, brief.
